lines.en: Would you like to respond to this message?
: {i}I can't wait to tell Rin you sent this to me and cause even more drama in your life.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我等不及要告诉 Rin 你把这个发给我了，好让你的生活再多出一点狗血。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can't wait until you're dead.{/i}
: {i}Just kidding.{/i}
: {i}Maybe.{/i}
: {i}Are you enjoying the picture you received in exchange?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你收到的那张交换来的照片，看得还开心吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm trying to, but some creep keeps texting me and I don't know how to make him go away.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在努力看了，可有个变态一直给我发短信，我不知道该怎么让他消失。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You should just talk to him instead. He can probably do more for you than a picture ever could.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你应该干脆跟他说说话。他能为你做的，大概比一张照片多得多。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I doubt it. He seems like a loser and probably doesn't practice safe sex. And also, I'm an obedient Christian girl.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我怀疑。他看起来像个废物，大概还不知道安全性行为。而且，我是个听话的基督徒女孩。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}My favorite kind.{/i}
: {i}Are you actually religious?{/i}
: {i}That's a weird question to ask someone who just sent you a picture of a naked girl.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}问一个刚给你发了裸体女孩照片的人这种问题，还挺怪的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You can be religious and still send people pictures of naked girls.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个人可以一边信教，一边给别人发裸体女孩的照片。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}By any chance, did the part of your brain that processes sarcasm go to shit during your coma? I don't know if I should feel bad for you or not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有没有可能，你脑子里负责处理讽刺的那部分在你昏迷的时候坏掉了？我不知道该不该同情你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm just trying to learn more about you.{/i}
: {i}Not the reaction I expected from sending you a naked picture of my ex.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}给你发了我前任的裸照，我可没料到会是这个反应。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why? I think this is a good bonding experience for us.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？我觉得这对我们来说是一次很好的增进感情的经历。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, I think we could get a lot closer if you sent me more pictures of your hot idol girlfriend.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，我觉得你要是再多发几张你那个火辣偶像女友的照片，我们能亲近很多。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}How about one of me instead?{/i}
: {i}Please don't. I like this phone and I don't want to have to throw it away.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别。我喜欢这部手机，我可不想把它扔了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I wouldn't have sent one anyway.{/i}
: {i}Cool. Can you go away now so I can get back to doing my homework?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}酷。那你现在能走了吗，我好回去写作业。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You're not doing your homework, Otoha. We both know that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你根本没在写作业，Otoha。我们俩都清楚。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then why even point it out????? Why will you not let me be free?????{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你干嘛还要指出来？？？？？你为什么就是不肯放过我？？？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because I'm in love with you.{/i}
: {i}Okay.{/i}
: {i}Will you accept my feelings?{/i}
: {i}Who is this again?{/i}
: {i}Rin. You've been set up.{/i}
: {i}Hi Rin.{/i}
: {i}How could you betray me like this?{/i}
: {i}Finger slipped. Sorry.{/i}
: {i}Remember the first time we made out? Can you please recap that in vivid details please?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还记得我们第一次接吻吗？能不能请你生动详细地复述一遍？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sure.{/i}
: {i}It all started one snowy winter night in my grandfather's log cabin. I'd just returned from a week-long bear hunt and was excited to finally get to watch Wheel of Fortune with my cat.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一切始于一个飘雪的冬夜，在我祖父的木屋里。我刚结束了为期一周的猎熊归来，正兴奋地终于可以跟我的猫一起看《命运之轮》了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I lied. It's still me, your former teacher.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我骗你的。还是我，你的前老师。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Otoha I really want to kill myself.{/i}
: {i}Is someone paying you to prevent me from getting off? How am I supposed to do my homework now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是有人花钱雇你来阻止我高潮吗？我现在还怎么写作业？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have teaching experience. I can come help you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我有教学经验。我可以过去帮你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No, you might kill yourself on the way.{/i}
: {i}Yeah, good point.{/i}
: {i}Do you actually need me to call you right now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你真的需要我现在给你打电话吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No, I'll be fine.{/i}
: {i}Are you sure?{/i}
: {i}Yeah. Go do your homework. I'm sorry for bothering you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯。去写作业吧。抱歉打扰你了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay.{/i}
: {i}You can text me again later if you want. I don't care.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你想的话，晚点可以再给我发短信。我不介意。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maybe. Later, Otoha.{/i}
: {i}Later, Akira :){/i}
